override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Noah (RL/Wind/Defender/Burst II) is an entirely defensive kit — there is not one offensive line in any of the three slots. S1: 10%-on-being-attacked team Damage Taken ▼8%/10s. S2: on a Full Charge hit, Taunt 2s + enemy ATK ▼13.25%/5s. Burst: self Taunt-all 10s, team Invulnerable 3s, team DEF ▲133.48%/10s. Only the burst DEF line maps to a real StatKey (defPct — documented inert in v1: self DEF does not affect own damage), and it is modeled for completeness/future consumers. Damage Taken ▼ is ALLY MITIGATION and is deliberately NOT encoded as damageTakenPct (that stat is a boss debuff where positive = boss takes MORE — encoding it would fabricate a team-wide +8% damage buff out of a defensive line). Taunt and Invulnerable have no schema primitive and no damage consequence against an immortal, non-damaging scope-lock boss. Enemy ATK ▼ is inert (no enemy ATK modeled). Expected sim contribution: her own weapon damage only.
